overview_text: Acme Robotics designs and manufactures warehouse automation robots and the software that coordinates them. Roughly 70% of revenue comes from recurring software/subscription fees attached to hardware already deployed; the remainder is one-time hardware sales. Main customers are mid-size logistics and e-commerce fulfillment operators.

risks_notes_text: Customer concentration: top 5 customers account for ~38% of revenue. Recent CFO departure adds near-term execution uncertainty. Sector faces a flagged component-shortage risk that could pressure hardware margins over the next 1-2 quarters. Valuation (31x trailing P/E) is above the industrials-automation peer median of ~22x.
